answer: Post each bond against a hardware root, not an address. Rotate that root only through a signed ceremony. Tax attestations that arrive from one subnet, so a rented rack pays triple to look like three agents. Score trust per completed task instead of per address, which lets one honest machine earn repeatedly while a thousand idle addresses earn nothing. A lagoon of cheap IPs stops looking deep, because that marble is expensive to fake and cheap to verify. One vertex, one bond, one bill.
